card.name: "and" after a baseline test before treatment
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after a phrase like "before starting [drug]" or "prior to administration", in monitoring instructions. It leads into a follow-up such as "periodically thereafter" or "during treatment".

modes.label: Before start, then ongoing
modes.description: "and" joins a pre-treatment lab check to repeated checks later.
modes.example: Measure serum potassium before starting eplerenone tablets<< and>> periodically thereafter.

modes.label: After a drug name
modes.description: "and" follows a brand name that ends the "before initiating" phrase.
modes.example: Assess left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) before starting MARGENZA<< and>> regularly during treatment.

card.writes: It favors words meaning "whenever" or "every time", which hints at recurring timing in what follows.
card.plain: It marks the "and" that links a check before treatment to repeat checks during treatment.
